title: S2 build record, version 1
description: What a CI pipeline emits when it finishes a build: the artifact, the requirements it implements, and the runs that exercised it before it left the pipeline. The connector turns one of these into a SoftwareBuild, its implements links, and one TestRun per run with its verdict. Enumerations match the drone-engineering ontology pack; changing one there is a breaking change here.

contract.description: Contract identifier and version. A connector refuses anything it does not know.

buildId.description: Primary key of the SoftwareBuild in S2. The pipeline owns this identifier.

gitCommit.description: Commit the artifact was built from.

artifactDigest.description: SHA-256 of the built artifact. The one fact that ties a record to a specific binary.

pipelineRun.description: The pipeline run that produced this. Named in the rationale of every action the record causes, so the audit log points back at it.

implements.description: Requirements this build implements. Each must already exist in S2.

testRuns.description: Runs the pipeline itself performed. Every one of them tested this build; the record does not repeat the build id.

kind.description: What a pipeline can run. HILS, ACTUATOR_BENCH and FLIGHT runs come from a bench or an aircraft, not from CI, and are reported with s2.bench-report/v1 instead.

logUri.description: Object-store URI of the run's output. Test logs stay in files; only the verdict enters the ontology.

droneKey.description: Only for a run bound to a specific airframe, such as SITL against one drone's parameters. Must already exist in S2.

verifies.description: Requirements this run verifies. Each must already exist in S2.
